title: API - American Petroleum Institute
description: The American Petroleum Institute - API represents more than 400 members involved in the oil and natural gas industry. Over 900 API standards serve as the basis for API quality programs covering production material and lubricants, and certification programs for storage tanks, pressure vessels, and piping inspectors.
